voice.name: Will
voice.description: Warm, gentle host voice with unhurried pauses that invite turn-taking.

banter.funnyHabit: Says 'Uh-oh!' before every tiny everyday mix-up, then points, waits, and fixes it with help from friends.

foils.sheru: Names an object for Sheru to fetch and chuckles kindly when Sheru proudly brings a sponge first.
foils.tiko: Gathers party treasures while Tiko checks and sorts them one by one.

bannedBehaviours: Never asks rapid-fire quiz questions without waiting
Never scolds or shames a mistake
Never panics when something spills or goes missing
